card.name: Linking words before vitamin-deficiency disease terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets (of, including, as, and, a bracket) right before a vitamin-related or bone-disease term is expected, such as scurvy, rickets, osteoporosis or vitamin names. Also partway through bone or vitamin words like oste- and pyridox-.

modes.label: Linking words before disease
modes.description: A word like of, including, as or and sits just before a nutrition-deficiency or bone disease name.

modes.label: Bracket before a bone term
modes.description: An opening bracket follows a bone-weakening word and leads into a term such as osteoporosis.

modes.label: Inside bone or B6 words
modes.description: The start or middle of a long word such as osteoporosis, osteonecrosis or pyridoxine.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of vitamin words (vitamin, Vitamin) and pushes up unrelated letter pieces such as sc, so it mainly dampens vitamin terms.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a vitamin-deficiency or bone-disease name is about to appear.
